issues.quote: Faint, and quick, and from the top of the house. That is all I have to say of them.
issues.fact: B4 places the bells at the master's window up above, and the transcript itself earlier names that window. The sheet does not say the bells came from the top of the house in general.
issues.misreading: A solver could read 'the top of the house' as a different source from the master's window, such as the atelier on the top floor, and so draw a different conclusion about where the bells came from.
